text:
Marco (Sales): Quick handoff — Polaris (mid-market fintech) signed pilot for Private deploy + Dedicated burst. Need CS + eng runbook before org security review on Mon. Renewal window in 11 months; flagged as medium risk because security review timeline is long.

Priya (CS): Thanks Marco — picking this up. Key asks from sales: full SSO + KMS integration, data residency in eu-west-1, and a 2-week eval with 5 power users. Can we get eng support for SSO connector ASAP?

Marco (Sales): Yep. Security wants SAML + OIDC fallback. They also asked for audit log export cadence (daily) and HSM/KMS proof.

Ethan (Eng): I can own the SSO connector work and the private deploy tweaks. ETA: initial config + test endpoint by Fri. Will need a sample IdP metadata file from Polaris and the SP redirect URI we set.

Priya (CS): Action items: 1) Marco to get IdP metadata (owner: Marco) 2) Ethan to prepare SP and test endpoint (owner: Ethan) 3) Sam to open support runbook ticket and monitoring hooks (owner: Sam) 4) Lina to do a quick security checklist for KMS/HSM (owner: Lina). Target: internal dry-run next Tue.

Sam (Support): Opening runbook now: TKT-5421. I'll add steps for token rotation, alerts for auth failures, and a dashboard for user-seat sync. Will also add play for rollback to hosted model if private deploy fails.

Lina (Security): I can validate KMS integrations but need the customer's KMS type and access pattern. Also ask for expected retention for audit logs. If they require HSM-backed keys we need legal signoff for HSM onboarding (timeline +2w).

Marco (Sales): I'll request KMS details and retention policy from the Polaris SOC. Will share IdP metadata by EOD tomorrow.

Ethan (Eng): For testing — I'll publish a test SP at https://polaris-internal-test.redwood.net/sso/callback and add these redirect URIs: 
```
https://polaris.app/sso/callback
https://polaris-admin.app/sso/callback
```
Quick validation curl for token introspect: 
```
curl -X POST https://polaris-internal-test.redwood.net/oauth/introspect -d 'token=REDACTED' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <svc-token>'
```
Add me to the Polaris dev Slack channel so I can copy logs.

Priya (CS): Planning enablement session: Wed 10am PT with product + operations; invite list: 5 pilot admins + Polaris engineering. I'll draft the invite and add runbook link.

Sam (Support): Added oncall hooks to TKT-5421 and created a Grafana dashboard stub (dash ID: 8032). Will wire alert: auth.failure.rate > 1% sustained -> page oncall.

Lina (Security): For KMS: if they want Bring-Your-Own-KMS we'll need an E2EE design review. I'll queue a quick checklist: key rotation policy, HSM requirement, cross-region replication.

Marco (Sales): FYI — renewal sensitivity: their CFO asked to see cost estimates if we need to run dedicated burst for peak load. Might need Redwood Optimize recommendations. Sales will share expected qps.

Priya (CS): Ok — I'll compile an enablement + cost brief for Wed session. Next check-in: Tue 9am PT to confirm dry-run readiness.

Ethan (Eng): Noted. I'll drop artifacts in the runbook ticket (INF-7892) and attach logs from test endpoint.

DeployBot: Deployment scheduled: private-preview/polaris-sso -> Fri 16:00 UTC (auto-notify on success/failure).

Priya (CS): Summary of owners & next steps (copying into thread):
- Marco (Sales): get IdP metadata + KMS details (due: TOMORROW EOD)
- Ethan (Eng): publish test SP, endpoint, and attach test logs to INF-7892 (due: Fri)
- Sam (Support): create runbook + monitoring hooks (TKT-5421) (due: Thu)
- Lina (Security): KMS/HSM checklist + triage for E2EE (due: Thu)
- Priya (CS): enablement invite + cost brief (due: Tue 8am PT)

Priya (CS): I'll run the Tue 9am dry-run and confirm go/no-go for Wed enablement. If security blocks HSM onboarding we'll prepare fallback (hosted with VPC peering).

Marco (Sales): Thanks team. Adding Polaris execs to the invite and will push for metadata. :thumbsup:

Ethan (Eng): +1. If anyone needs logs earlier DM me.

Sam (Support): I put the runbook link in TKT-5421.

Priya (CS): Closing loop here — will escalate in this thread if anything slips.

(End of thread)
